title: Lizards and Basements 2
statementMd:
*This is simplified version of the problem used on the original contest. The original problem seems to have too difiicult solution. The constraints for input data have been reduced.*

Polycarp likes to play computer role-playing game «Lizards and Basements». At the moment he is playing it as a magician. At one of the last levels he has to fight the line of archers. The only spell with which he can damage them is a fire ball. If Polycarp hits the $*i*$-th archer with his fire ball (they are numbered from left to right), the archer loses $*a*$ health points. At the same time the spell damages the archers adjacent to the $*i*$-th (if any) — they lose $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10$) health points each.

As the extreme archers (i.e. archers numbered 1 and $*n*$) are very far, the fire ball cannot reach them. Polycarp can hit any other archer with his fire ball.

The amount of health points for each archer is known. An archer will be killed when this amount is less than 0. What is the minimum amount of spells Polycarp can use to kill all the enemies?

Polycarp can throw his fire ball into an archer if the latter is already killed.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*, *a*, *b*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$; $1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10$). The second line contains a sequence of $*n*$ integers — $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 15$), where $*h*_{*i*}$ is the amount of health points the $*i*$-th archer has.

## Output

In the first line print $*t*$ — the required minimum amount of fire balls.

In the second line print $*t*$ numbers — indexes of the archers that Polycarp should hit to kill all the archers in $*t*$ shots. All these numbers should be between 2 and $*n* - 1$. Separate numbers with spaces. If there are several solutions, output any of them. Print numbers in any order.
statementZhMd:
*这是原比赛中使用的题目的简化版本。原题似乎需要过于困难的解法。输入数据的约束已经缩小。*

Polycarp 喜欢玩电脑角色扮演游戏《Lizards and Basements》。目前，他在游戏中扮演一名魔法师。在最后几个关卡中的一个关卡里，他必须与一列弓箭手战斗。他唯一能够伤害弓箭手的法术是火球术。如果 Polycarp 用火球术击中第 $*i*$ 个弓箭手（弓箭手从左到右编号），该弓箭手会损失 $*a*$ 点生命值。同时，法术还会伤害与第 $*i*$ 个弓箭手相邻的弓箭手（如果存在），它们各自损失 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10$）点生命值。

由于两侧最外面的弓箭手（即编号为 1 和 $*n*$ 的弓箭手）距离很远，火球术无法击中他们。Polycarp 可以用火球术击中其他任意弓箭手。

每个弓箭手的生命值都是已知的。当弓箭手的生命值小于 0 时，他会被杀死。Polycarp 至少需要使用多少次法术才能杀死所有敌人？

即使某个弓箭手已经被杀死，Polycarp 仍然可以向他投掷火球术。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *a*, *b*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$；$1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10$）。第二行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列——$*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n}$（$1 ≤ *h*_{*i} ≤ 15$），其中 $*h*_{*i}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个弓箭手的生命值。

## 输出格式

第一行输出 $*t*$——所需的最少火球术次数。

第二行输出 $*t*$ 个整数——Polycarp 为了在 $*t*$ 次攻击中杀死所有弓箭手而应击中的弓箭手编号。所有编号都必须在 2 和 $*n* - 1$ 之间。请用空格分隔这些编号。如果有多种方案，输出任意一种即可。编号可以按任意顺序输出。
